en.headline: Singapore bagel brand Two Men Bagel House soft-opens in Sai Ying Pun
en.dek: The hand-rolled New York-style bagels from the Singapore chain that has run since 2014 have arrived at King’s Hill on Western Street.
body: Two Men Bagel House, the Singapore bagel shop founded in 2014, has soft-opened its first Hong Kong outlet in Sai Ying Pun. The store occupies Shop A at King’s Hill, 38 Western Street.

The brand, which operates five shops in Singapore and one in Bangkok, offers hand-rolled bagels with fillings that include cream cheese and lox, bacon and scrambled egg, roast beef with jalapeño relish, and chicken with pesto. Bagel flavours listed at the soft opening include plain, sesame, garlic and onion, and Cheddar and jalapeño, with cream cheese options such as scallion and peanut butter and jam.

Seating is available at the rear of the shop. The company was incorporated in Hong Kong earlier this year. No exact opening hours or full menu prices beyond selected items have been confirmed by the operators in public announcements.

zh.headline: 新加坡貝果品牌Two Men Bagel House西營盤軟開業
zh.dek: 自2014年經營的新加坡連鎖店，手搓紐約風格貝果進駐西街King’s Hill。
body: 新加坡貝果店Two Men Bagel House已在西營盤軟開業，這是品牌在香港的首間分店。店舖位於西街38號King’s Hill的A舖。
品牌在新加坡有五間分店，曼谷亦有一間，提供手搓貝果，餥料包括忌廉芝士配煙三文魚、煙肉配炒蛋、烤牛肉配墨西哥辣椒醬，以及雞肉配青醬。軟開業期間的貝果口味包括原味、芝麻、蒜蔥及車打芝士墨西哥辣椒，忌廉芝士選擇則有蔥花及花生醬果醬等。
店舖後方設有座位。公司早前已在香港註冊成立。營辦商公開資料未有確認確切營業時間及完整菜單價錢。
